# Hollywood Camera Work

> > Professional filmmaking education featuring The Master Course in High-End Blocking and Staging, Directing Actors, and VFX For Directors training programs, plus Shot Designer and Causality Story Sequencer software tools.

Hollywood Camera Work is a leading provider of professional film education created by Per Holmes, offering comprehensive training in camera work, blocking and staging, directing actors, and visual effects. The site also features the Prep Show and Hot Moves Show, along with production planning software for filmmakers.

## Key Topics

- The Master Course
- Blocking and Staging
- Directing Actors
- Visual Effects For Directors
- Per Holmes
- Shot Designer
- Causality Story Sequencer
- Prep Show
- Hot Moves Show
- Camera Work Techniques
- Green Screen and Matchmoving
- Actor Rehearsal and Readthroughs
- Filmmaking Training
- High-End Blocking
- Film Education

## Training Courses

- [Master Course Downloads](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/the-master-course-downloads.html): Downloadable scripts and blocking diagrams for Master Course students
- [Directing Actors Scripts & Worksheets](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/directing-actors-downloads.html): Scripts and worksheets for Directing Actors course exercises
- [VFX For Directors Sample Clips](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/visual-effects-for-directors-sample-clips.html): Sample clips showcasing VFX For Directors training content and techniques

## Prep Show & Hot Moves Show

- [Hollywood Camera Work Blog](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/blog.html): Main blog hub featuring Prep Show and Hot Moves Show content
- [Prep Show: Actor Readthroughs](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/prep-show-actor-readthroughs.html): Prep Show topic on actor readthroughs, submissions, and casting calls
- [Prep Show: Actor Rehearsal](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/prep-show-actor-rehearsal.html): Prep Show topic on actor rehearsal and casting submission requirements
- [Submit As An Actor](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/prep-show-submit-as-an-actor.html): Actor submission form for Prep Show character workshopping and rehearsal
- [Suggest Hot Moves Episodes](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/hot-moves-suggest-episode.html): Contact form for suggesting Hot Moves Show episode topics

## Software & Tools

- [App Activations](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/app-activations.html): Manage license activations for Causality and Shot Designer apps
- [Causality Dev Downloads](https://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/causality-dev.html): Development version downloads for Causality Story Sequencer software
